usage: cpuctl [ list ]
       cpuctl { offline | online } <cpu> [ <cpu>... ]


CPUCTL(8)                             System Manager's Manual                            CPUCTL(8)

NNAAMMEE
     ccppuuccttll – program to control CPUs

SSYYNNOOPPSSIISS
     ccppuuccttll _c_o_m_m_a_n_d [_a_r_g_u_m_e_n_t_s]

DDEESSCCRRIIPPTTIIOONN
     The ccppuuccttll command can be used to control and inspect the state of CPUs in the system.

     The first argument, _c_o_m_m_a_n_d, specifies the action to take.  Valid commands are:

     list     For each CPU in the system, display the current state and time of the last state
              change.

     offline _c_p_u [_c_p_u _._._.]
              Set the specified CPUs off line.

              At least one CPU in the system must remain on line.

     online _c_p_u [_c_p_u _._._.]
              Set the specified CPUs on line.

EEXXAAMMPPLLEESS
     Run
           cpuctl offline 2
     and then
           cpuctl list
     The output should reflect the fact that CPU#2 was taken offline.

Darwin                                    March 18, 2019                                 CPUCTL(8)
